headline: US ACA Health Insurance Premiums Set to Rise 13% Next Year
summary: Affordable Care Act premiums are scheduled to rise by 13% next year, with enrollees earning over $64,000 seeing higher out-of-pocket costs despite offsetting federal subsidies.
why: Premium rate adjustments affect health insurance carrier loss ratios, medical cost trends, and federal healthcare subsidies.

impacts.name: US Health Insurance
impacts.why: ACA premium increases will impact enrollee affordability and insurer gross receipts.
